scope: Finite original A8F0 low-y VRAM rectangle moves with signed-WORD descriptors, overlap/page-crossing/empty cases, and one original A710 same-map source alias. No full domain or storage ownership claim.

notification.disabled_fixture: callback pointer nonzero, gate zero; original BD80 gate returns and the call fully unwinds
notification.enabled_fixture: callback pointer and gate nonzero; original BD80 jump reaches an empty synthetic executable endpoint hook, captures original entry state, then emulator stops before executing any callback byte

execution.data_restore_per_case: entire mapped .data image restored to pre-fixture bytes and compared byte-for-byte

address_model.bounded_domain: 0<=x<1024 words; 0<=y<512 rows; nonnegative width/height; rectangles remain within bounds

limitations: Finite synthetic fixtures only; negative coordinates, clipping/invalid extents, y>=512, and full callback domain are unproved.
The tested address formula is not an allocation-ownership or 2MiB backing claim.
A8F0's forward overlap result is specific to tested row and x-page cases; no universal overlap contract beyond those cases is claimed.
The enabled notification case stops at the original callback endpoint without executing callback code; only gate-zero fixtures fully return through BD80.
No DirectDraw, raster output, gameplay, FUNCTION_MATCH, source identity, or whole-module equality is claimed.
